scene: dusk aangan: mother cooking on chulha, father returning on bicycle
slogan: Maa-Papa ki dua saath chalti hai, toh raaste khud aasaan ho jaate hain.

scene: winter sunrise potters lane: potter at chaak, drying matkas, brick kiln, women carrying matkas to well
slogan: Chaak pe ghoomti mitti bhi, MEHNAT se hi bartan banti hai.

scene: winter afternoon village rooftops: kids flying a kite with charkhi, dadi on charpai with peanuts and gur, kites in sky, mustard fields beyond
slogan: Chhat ki patangein aaj bhi dil ko UDAAN sikhati hain.

scene: misty winter sunrise river ghat: boatman poling a wooden boat with two villagers, stone steps with brass lotas, banyan tree, egrets, cows and mustard fields on far bank, mud houses with chulha smoke
slogan: Lehron se na lado, saath BEHNA seekho, kinara mil jayega.
